risk_and_mitigation: SP-API private-developer approval delayed or denied → R0 cannot ingest live data. Mitigation: apply immediately; build against recorded fixtures; escalate through a Seller Support case [S28].

Ads API access timing UNVERIFIED [S33] → the R1 Advertising line and parallel run lack ad spend (WP-37). Mitigation: apply for Amazon Ads API access (spend reporting only) and authorise Google Ads / Meta reads at R0; per-platform CSV export as fallback, flagged ESTIMATE (§15.2).
Shopify `read_all_orders` refused → history limited to 60 days [S20]. Mitigation: Sellerboard.io exports for older history; document the limitation on screens.
*Closed at v0.3.* Brand Registry no longer gates any scope; the features it gated (F-E07, F-E08, F-E09, F-E16) are OMITTED (DC-14).
Finances API lag (the last 48 h may be missing [S45]) and ~42-day ad restatements [S34] → figures move after first display. Mitigation: "provisional" badge until settlement; re-pull windows.
Historical COGS incomplete → margins flagged incomplete for early periods. Mitigation: A-07; migration reconciliation and parallel run.

Automation misconfiguration causes harmful price changes (repricer, R4). Mitigation: REQ-176 framework (WP-20); canary limits; kill-switch drills. Bid-change risk no longer applies (ad writes are OMITTED, REQ-188).
Key-person dependency on the finance controller for reconciliation, tax masters and parallel-run sign-off. Mitigation: documented close checklist; deputy named; parallel-run workload planned (§21).
Protected-data misuse (Shopify L2, Amazon PII, B2B contact data). Mitigation: L1 default; minimised B2B contact fields; retention jobs; audit.

Scope creep from extended connectors (R5) or from re-introducing marketing features piecemeal. Mitigation: each connector requires an explicit CCB adoption decision; any OMITTED item needs a new Owner decision and re-estimate (§27).

GST rate change for the products' HSN codes, or other GST notification changes during build or after go-live → wrong GST split or net sales. Mitigation: HSN rate master with effective dates (CALC-094; SCR-128); no hard-coded rates; GST-rate-change chart annotation (U8); §25 update target; golden vectors parameterised by rate.

CA confirmations outstanding on the ⚠ items (IRN/AATO, e-way thresholds, credit-note limits, TDS 194Q / s.393, MSME applicability, current HSN rate) → B2B tax masters cannot go live, or flags mislead. Mitigation: R1 entry-gate dependency; flags shipped read-only and labelled "not CA-confirmed" until confirmed; no filing functions in scope.

B2B double counting. B2B sales are keyed in Shopify as draft orders, appear as Amazon Business orders, or are intercompany → inflated sales in the unified view (§5.7 #4). Mitigation: CALC-100 duplicate block with explicit linking (REQ-182, GV-113); intercompany elimination (REQ-181, GV-114); order inclusion rules (CALC-090); parallel-run check against the accounting sales register (§15.2).

Courier / 3PL cost data unavailable or not order-matchable (e.g., the fulfilment partner provides only invoice-level totals) → Shopify profit stays overstated (§5.7 #1). Mitigation: F-D16/CON-32 CONDITIONAL; estimates flagged ESTIMATE (CALC-105); invoice-level allocation by driver with conservation (CALC-067) as a fallback (PROPOSED); "% estimated shipping" on the completeness bar (SCR-130).

Attribution misuse. *Reduced at v0.3.* No attribution view is built (DC-14), so reported and attributed sales cannot be added together in the application. Residual risk: platform-reported ROAS from the ad platforms' own consoles is used for budget decisions outside the application. Mitigation: the dashboard shows Blended ROAS / POAS (CALC-059) and TACOS from total sales; REQ-162 stops any platform-attributed revenue entering sales; training in WP-29.

R1 size and schedule. R1 grows to 4,200 direct hours (including WP-37) and 14 weeks, plus a two-month parallel run, so the risk of slippage rises. Mitigation: B2B receivables/export, consolidation and LTV kept in R2; CONDITIONAL items hold reserve hours; weekly burn-up against WP hours; descoping by CCB if needed.

Vendor definition drift. Sellerboard changes a metric definition during the parallel run → compat mode no longer matches. Mitigation: gap register review at each gate (§27); compat-mode definitions versioned; variances explained, not forced.

Settlement reports age out before a live system exists. Amazon report documents are kept 90 days, and production exists only after the R0 gate. Mitigation: Ops downloads every settlement flat file monthly from now (§15.1); files are registered and imported at migration.

Cloud cost under-estimated. The ₹1,29,000/month cloud subtotal is a planning estimate for a Multi-AZ, multi-account design. Mitigation: Owner-approved AWS Pricing Calculator estimate before the first production apply (§12.1); AWS Budgets alarms.

Marketplace developer access lead times (v0.3). Walmart (US/CA/MX), eBay and TikTok Shop seller accounts and developer / partner API access, and SP-API authorisation for each further Amazon region, have unknown lead times and approval criteria → WP-23 / WP-38 cannot be tested on live data inside the 14-week R2. Mitigation: apply for each account and API access during R1 (A-13, A-01); build against recorded synthetic fixtures (GV-152…GV-154); release each channel independently when its access arrives; slip a channel through change control rather than ship it untested.

Codex cloud features in transition (v0.3). At 2026-10-10 Codex cloud is moving to a new environment experience, while code review and the GitHub integration still run on Codex Cloud (Legacy) [S59] → set-up steps or review behaviour may change during the build. Mitigation: file 12 records the exact set-up used; branch protection, CI and the developer's own review are the real merge gates, so a Codex review outage never blocks or weakens acceptance; file 07 (Claude Code pack) remains an optional fallback.

PROPOSED channel mapping differs from Sellerboard (v0.3). The Walmart / eBay / TikTok Shop line mapping (CALC-114) and the fee-code maps and tax regimes (CALC-113) of every Amazon marketplace other than IN were not observed in Sellerboard → numbers may differ from Sellerboard once those accounts exist. Mitigation: mapping tables versioned and data-driven; "mapping not yet verified" badge; one-month parallel run per channel (§15.2); CA review of each tax regime (A-22).

R2 size and integration load (v0.3). R2 grows from 520 h / 10 weeks to 1,240 h / 14 weeks, with 840 h of integration work (WP-23, WP-38). Mitigation: integration capacity held at R1 level (§21); channels released one by one; overlap with R3 only by DC-05 decision.
